data.title: Sazan Gakyuu
data.synopsis:
A collection of original short series with 15-second long episodes.

Lonely Ramen
In the vast ocean of soup, the ramen fairy wanders back and forth on her bamboo shoot raft. What kind of ingredient (friend) will she meet today?

Waku Moiselle
A giant object appears in the clear sky, and in the midst of an abnormal situation that shakes up everyday life, a powerful and tempting moiselle, unaware of her own wisdom, shines a light on Japan.

Blood Monsters
The Blood Monsters are monsters based on blood types. They compete with each other every day to scare each other, by hiding in the shadows, yelling, or using various other methods. Take a look at the daily lives of these mischievous kids.

(Source: X, translated)

data.title: Lao Ma Yu Xiao Bai
data.synopsis:
Lao Ma, whose full name is Ma Lei and whose online name is "Ma Mou Ren", is a well-known game planner. Many of his mobile games have dominated the top of the "Lemon Best-selling" TOP list for many years. Lao Ma's production style is actually not well received in the game circle, but big companies are still flocking to him, and the core lies in the word traffic. Lao Ma's games have no breakthroughs in mechanism, and most of the games he planned are just reskins, but Lao Ma has a deep grasp of people's hearts, and often a simple small change can make players enjoy krypton gold. On an ordinary and easy-going morning in 2021, this well-known planner was fatefully transported into the mobile game world he designed himself. At first, he went smoothly with his understanding of the game, but gradually things began to collapse more and more. The bad design he made in order to cheat produced all kinds of amazing and strange changes. In addition to Lao Ma himself "enjoying" all this, there is also a new finger named "Xiao Bai" beside him...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

data.title: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Chapon no Hero!
data.title_japanese: それいけ！アンパンマン チャポンのヒーロー！
data.synopsis:
Centers on Chapon, a mysterious boy who falls from the sky without any knowledge of where he came from. Staying with Anpanman, he one day helps someone out and gets to know the joy of making someone smile, and dreams of becoming a hero like Anpanman. But when Baikinman arrives, and reveals the secret of Chapon's origins, Chapon must figure out if his origins or his dreams define who he is.

(Source: ANN)

data.title: Wo de Shizun Shi Wukong
data.synopsis:
Yuan Huai participated in his family's trials, but during the trials, villains stole his chance to cultivate immortality. His mother was murdered, his sister was kidnapped, and he himself was severely injured and thrown off a cliff. On the verge of death at the bottom of the cliff, he encountered Sun Wukong, who had been suppressed under Five Fingers Mountain ten thousand years ago. He gained the opportunity to become Sun Wukong's disciple and was reborn. He escaped from the bottom of the cliff to avenge his mother, and with Sun Wukong's help, he entered the immortal realm and embarked on the path of cultivating immortality to save his sister.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
